title: Veteran Entertainment Executive and Industry Dealmaker Ron Bension Joins VENU as Strategic Advisor to CEO
summary: Former ASM Global CEO and architect of its $2.3 billion Legends acquisition to advise VENU on strategic opportunities and shareholder value Venu Holding Corporation ("VENU" or the "Company") (NYSE AMERICAN: VENU), an owner, operator, and developer of premium live entertainment destinations, today announced that Ron Bension, former President and CEO of ASM Global, has joined the Company as a strategic advisor to Founder, Chairman, and CEO J.W. Roth. Bension has also been nominated for election to VENU's Board of Directors at the Company's 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders, subject to shareholder approval. In his advisory role, Bension will work directly with Roth to evaluate strategic growth opportunities for the Company. Ron Bension Bension brings more than 50 years of experience in the live entertainment and venue management industry to the role at VENU.
